lane: Cross-cutting integration of Batch C: backend (Tarot note, reader router), model campaigns, mobile Tarot note and reader suggestion, Admin campaigns page
goal: Merge the four Batch C branches and close the contracts between them: campaigns wired into resolveFeatureRoute, one product-event contract between the app and share-events, the note allowance separate from the interpret allowance, mobile parsers matching the real ai-tarot-reading answers, and pick-winner working for features without an active route.
successCriteria: resolveFeatureRoute reads the active route, then applies a running campaign (service-role client) and returns experiment {campaignId, variant}; no campaign or any campaign error keeps the active route with experiment null; Deno tests cover all three cases and there is no circular import.
The tarot note, suggest_reader and interpret paths put campaignId and variant as flat trace metadata keys and return experiment in the answer.

Mobile sendProductEvent sends exactly the share-events shape {events:[{name, metadata}]} with only allowed keys and values; one real payload is accepted by the server parser and asserted on both sides.
The note allowance (1 delivered a Vietnam day, failed attempts not counted) is separate from the interpret allowance; verified by handler tests.
tarotNote.ts parsers read the real handler answers (status codes, noteStatus created/replayed, nextNoteAt, safety.crisis, moderationStatus, model object, experiment) with one test per contract.

Pick winner supplies the feature's default response schema when the feature has no active route (tarot_note_output_v1, reader_router_choice_v1) in the Admin page and in SQL, and a reader_router winner whose first step is a decision provider publishes its chat steps as primary and fallback.
untouchedSurfaces: PLAN.md is updated by the lead agent.
Route publish function, prompt library, other AI features' Edge Functions and the mobile UI layout are not changed.
No migration is applied, no function deployed, no secret read.

impact.entryPoint: No new entry point. Tarot result screen (note box, reader suggestion) and Admin > Model và chiến dịch behave as merged.
impact.dataWrite: No new table. Trace metadata gains flat campaignId/variant keys; product_signal usage_events rows now actually arrive from the app.
impact.backendContract: ai-tarot-reading answers gain experiment on interpret; share-events contract unchanged (the app is aligned to it); campaigns migration pick-winner gains a default response schema and chat-step primary.
impact.adminVisibility: Campaign metrics can group runs by variant once the runtime tags traces.
impact.privacySafety: Product events carry only enumerated keys and slug or uuid values; question text cannot pass the client filter or the server allowlist.
impact.observability: Campaign tags in ai_trace_runs.metadata for tarot_reading, tarot_note and reader_router.
impact.rollback: End the campaign: runtime uses the active route. Code changes revert with the PR; migrations are unapplied.

canonicalContracts: share-events parseShareEvents/parseProductEvent is the product-event contract; the app follows it
parseRouteSteps (moved to _shared/model-route-steps.ts, re-exported by model-router.ts) stays the runtime step validator
nilaza_private.publish_model_route_config stays the only route publish path
